text: {"name":"bt_get_controller_state","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Selects a controller record, using the scan-command path when context flag bit 0 is set, and returns pointers to associated fields with a fallback to the context’s optional 16-bit field.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a1":"out_primary","a2":"out_secondary","v2":"controller_ctx","result":"record"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":2,"meaning":"Record field whose address is returned as the primary output."},{"offset":34,"meaning":"Controller-context byte; bit 0 selects the scan-command lookup path."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Optional controller-context 16-bit field; 0xffff indicates it is absent."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Record field whose 32-bit value is returned as the secondary output."}]}
